Violations and fines

Rules & Regulations 2024 §10: a complaint, a written notice, then either a fine the owner may appeal within 14 days, or a board hearing. Fines go on the unit owner's association account and can be taken out of the rent 2nd Chance collects. Waiving a fine needs a board decision.

  1. Record the complaint (choose the rule; the fine comes from the schedule).
  2. Send the notice: a fine notice (14 days to ask for a hearing) or a hearing notice.
  3. No hearing asked in 14 days: the automation makes the fine final and charges it. Hearing: the board votes on the decision under Board business.
  4. Continuing violations keep accruing under the schedule until you mark them cured.
